title: [Vulkan] Crash on device lost when calling `get_tree().quit()` (Windows, 4.3–4.5).
body:
### Tested versions Reproducible in: 4.3.stable, 4.4.1.stable, and 4.5.stable, ### System information Godot v4.5.stable (876b29033) - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA T1200 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8097) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-11950H @ 2.60GHz (16 threads) - 63.67 GiB memory ### Issue description The OS crashes after closing a running project, most of the times, the crash makes windows reboot, but I could reproduce this crash that didn't reboot and quickly took a screen, after 12 consecutive run and stop of the project:

Update 1: I was able to reproduce it on 4.4.1.stable after around 50 consecutive F5 and get_tree().quit()
I wasn't able to take any screenshot
Update 2: I was able to reproduce it on 4.3.stable after around 13 consecutive F5 and get_tree().quit() but this time the crash was different, and a different error appeared:
### Steps to reproduce The problem is that it is hard to reproduce, this have been a while since it started occurring for me and today I finally could take the screenshot of the stack trace ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22409695/mrp.zip) - Open the MRP - Press F5 - Press "backspace" (to execute `get_tree().quit()`) - Repeat until crash the happens
